messages:
Ethan L: Hey team, noticed my net pay dropped this cycle and there's a new line called 'Commuter PreTax PA' for $75. I live in NJ and have NJ on file. I only ever set up the commuter benefit for NYC transit, not PA. Anyone know why PA showed up?
Maya (People Ops): Thanks for the ping. Did you update any home/office addresses recently in Workday? Also which vendor is listed next to the deduction (TransitEase, Commutr, etc.)?
Ethan L: No address change in Workday. Deduction vendor shows 'TransitEase (Multi-jurisdiction)'. I did add an occasional client site in Philly to my calendar for 2 weeks last month but didn't change profile.
Chris - Payroll: Hi Ethan 30'm pulling the deduction mapping. If the vendor sends a payroll feed with a jurisdiction code PA, payroll auto-maps to state-level commuting pre-tax when address normalization flags a local site as active. We occasionally see vendor site codes for client locations. Can you DM the paystub screenshot?
Ethan L: Sent screenshot and last 4 SSN via DM. Screenshot shows two commuter lines: 'Commuter NYC - $50 pre-tax' and 'Commuter PA - $75 pre-tax'. I only enrolled in NYC.
Maya (People Ops): Looping TaxOps: @Chris can you check if any PA withholding or reporting was inadvertently triggered by the mapping? PA has local wage taxes in some municipalities.
Chris - Payroll: Quick check: no PA income tax withheld, only the pre-tax deduction line. That deduction reduces taxable wages reported to federal/NY/NJ based on the payroll jurisdiction table. We need to ensure the deduction wasn't treated as taxable for NJ or resulted in local PA wage reporting. I'll run a jurisdiction audit.
TaxOps Bot: Audit ticket TAX-3347 created: "TransitEase feed jurisdiction mismatch - Ethan L". Expected turnaround 2 business days.
Maya (People Ops): If audit finds it was mis-mapped we can reverse the PA line off-cycle and reclassify the deduction to NYC-only. Off-cycle will create an adjustment (shows as 'Commuter refund') and will correct year-to-date amounts.
Ethan L: Appreciate it. If it affects my W-2 allocation (NJ vs NY) what should I expect? I e-file my state returns so want to avoid surprises.
Chris - Payroll: If only the deduction line was wrong and no state withholding/reporting occurred, your W-2 allocation should remain the same. If the system created PA wage records, we may need to amend filings or issue W-2 corrections depending on the audit. We'll confirm after the audit completes.
Maya (People Ops): We'll follow up in this thread when TAX-3347 closes. Thanks for catching this early, Ethan. Please flag if you get any mail from local tax authorities. :eyes:
